thought.text: The `boards` dev server built successfully but exited with code 0 immediately. Let me investigate the `serve:instance` target definition to understand why.

reasoning_content:
The boards build succeeded, but the dev server exited immediately with exit code 0 — this is the classic behavior of `--watch=false` in non-TTY/nohup mode: Angular's dev server with `--watch=false` exits after the initial build (single build, no watch loop). Wait, but then the orchestrator would have to be handling this... let me look at the serve:instance target in the nx project. Maybe it expects a TTY, or maybe in the case of --watch=false the server is supposed to keep running, but something in the environment is causing it to exit.

Let me check the urboards project configuration and what serve:instance does. Also, let me check whether app and cms also exit in the same way (since boards crashed first, they got stopped).

Let's look at the nx target.

action.command: cd /workspace/app && grep -rn "serve:instance" apps/urboards/project.json apps/app/project.json apps/cms/project.json 2>/dev/null | head; echo ===; sed -n '/"serve:instance"/,/^      }/p' apps/urboards/project.json 2>/dev/null | head -30
